comparison.objective: Tighten a toggle-bolt hook to a hollow panel, versus adjust and lock a damper setting.
comparison.physical_skill: Screwdriver tightening while managing a captive toggle differs from loosening a recessed setscrew, tuning a collar, relocking, and cycling the axis.
comparison.success_condition: Hook flush, square, and resistant to a 5 N pull versus two acceptable dynamic stops and a post-lock witness-torque drift check.
comparison.reason: This is the closest tool-and-retention analogue, but it tests structural fastening, not iterative adjustment of dynamic response; the retention tests also validate different outcomes.
